chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Handbook
chunks.text: Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Employees have a one-hour lunch break.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Handbook
chunks.text: Full-time employees receive 24 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation requests longer than five consecutive working days require manager approval. Unused vacation days do not automatically carry over to the next year unless HR grants an exception.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Handbook
chunks.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Employees absent for more than three consecutive working days must provide medical documentation.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Handbook
chunks.text: NovaTech observes the public holidays published by the local HR office for each employee's assigned country.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Handbook
chunks.text: New full-time employees complete a three-month probation period unless their employment agreement states otherwise.

chunks.title: NovaTech Remote Work Policy
chunks.text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Remote-work schedules must be approved by the employee's direct manager.

chunks.title: NovaTech Remote Work Policy
chunks.text: Employees must normally work from the country in which they are employed. Working from another country for more than 10 consecutive calendar days requires written approval from HR.

chunks.title: NovaTech Remote Work Policy
chunks.text: Remote employees must remain reachable through approved company communication tools during normal working hours.

chunks.title: NovaTech Remote Work Policy
chunks.text: Company-issued laptops must be used for company work when available. Employees are responsible for keeping company equipment physically secure while working remotely.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Access and Security Policy
chunks.text: Company passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Passwords must not be shared with other employees.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Access and Security Policy
chunks.text: Multi-factor authentication is required for all company accounts that support it.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Access and Security Policy
chunks.text: Employees must use their own assigned accounts. Shared administrative accounts are prohibited unless specifically approved by the IT Security team.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Access and Security Policy
chunks.text: Company computers must automatically lock after 10 minutes of inactivity.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Access and Security Policy
chunks.text:
Lost or stolen company devices must be reported to the IT Service Desk immediately.

Note: This policy does not contain guidance about entering confidential company information into public generative AI services.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Benefits Guide
chunks.text: Eligible full-time employees are enrolled in the company's standard health insurance plan after completing 30 days of employment.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Benefits Guide
chunks.text: Dental coverage is available to eligible full-time employees as part of the standard benefits package.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Benefits Guide
chunks.text: Full-time employees receive an annual wellness allowance of USD 500 for approved fitness, wellbeing, or ergonomic expenses.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Benefits Guide
chunks.text: Each full-time employee receives a professional development budget of USD 1,200 per calendar year. Manager approval is required before reimbursement.

chunks.title: NovaTech Employee Benefits Guide
chunks.text: Eligible employees may add qualifying dependents to supported insurance plans subject to the insurer's rules.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Setup Guide
chunks.text: New employees should sign in using the temporary credentials supplied by IT, immediately change their password, and enroll in multi-factor authentication.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Setup Guide
chunks.text:
Employees working outside a NovaTech office must use the company VPN when accessing internal systems.

If the VPN connection fails:
1. Confirm that the internet connection is working.
2. Restart the VPN client.
3. Re-authenticate using multi-factor authentication.
4. Restart the computer.
5. If the issue continues, contact the IT Service Desk.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Setup Guide
chunks.text: Company email must be accessed through approved email applications.

chunks.title: NovaTech IT Setup Guide
chunks.text: Employees should install software through the company software portal when an approved package is available.

chunks.title: NovaTech Engineering Practices
chunks.text: All production code changes require review and approval from at least one other engineer before merging.

chunks.title: NovaTech Engineering Practices
chunks.text: Direct pushes to the main branch are prohibited. Changes must be merged through an approved pull request.

chunks.title: NovaTech Engineering Practices
chunks.text: Critical application logic must have automated tests. Pull requests should not be merged when required CI checks are failing.

chunks.title: NovaTech Engineering Practices
chunks.text: API keys, passwords, access tokens, and private credentials must never be committed to source control.

chunks.title: NovaTech Engineering Practices
chunks.text: Production deployments require all mandatory CI checks to pass. Emergency changes must be documented after deployment.

chunks.title: NovaTech Information Classification Policy
chunks.text: Information classified as Public may be shared outside the company without special approval.

chunks.title: NovaTech Information Classification Policy
chunks.text: Internal information is intended for NovaTech employees and approved contractors. It should not be publicly distributed.

chunks.title: NovaTech Information Classification Policy
chunks.text:
Confidential information includes non-public financial information, customer data, security details, private source code, and sensitive business plans.

Confidential information may only be shared with people who are authorized to access it and have a legitimate business need.

chunks.title: NovaTech Information Classification Policy
chunks.text:
Restricted information includes authentication secrets, private cryptographic keys, and highly sensitive regulated data. Access must be explicitly authorized.

Note: This document classifies company information but does not define whether any specific generative AI service is approved for handling confidential information.

chunks.title: NovaTech Business Expense Policy
chunks.text: Employees traveling for approved business purposes may claim reasonable meal expenses up to USD 60 per day unless a local policy provides a different limit.

chunks.title: NovaTech Business Expense Policy
chunks.text: Hotels should normally be booked through the approved company travel platform.

chunks.title: NovaTech Business Expense Policy
chunks.text: Reasonable taxi, rideshare, rail, and public-transport expenses may be reimbursed when used for approved business travel.

chunks.title: NovaTech Business Expense Policy
chunks.text: Receipts are required for individual expenses of USD 25 or more.

chunks.title: NovaTech Business Expense Policy
chunks.text: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the expense is incurred.
